purpose: Freeze the source-faithful Mem-Gallery dialogue-to-record and answer-isolating question projection used by the seven control methods before the real dataset is materialized.

dialogue_projection.ordering: Sorted scenario files are handled by the accepted dataset identity; within one scenario preserve session list order and dialogue list order, skipping only rounds where both user and assistant strings are empty as the official runner does.
dialogue_projection.speaker_a: user (<character_profile.name>) when a nonempty name exists, otherwise user
dialogue_projection.raw_text: Join nonempty '<speaker>: <content>' segments with a newline.
dialogue_projection.image_selection: Use only input_image[0], image_caption[0], and image_id[0], matching the official runner; the accepted dataset audit still validates every listed image reference.
dialogue_projection.captioned_text:
For text controls append exactly '
image:
image_id: <id>
image_caption: <caption>' when the selected image has a nonempty source id or caption.
dialogue_projection.multimodal_text: For full-memory-mm retain raw_text separately and attach the first frozen image path rather than folding its caption into the text.
dialogue_projection.memory_id: <scenario>:session-<zero-based source session index>:round-<zero-based source round index>
dialogue_projection.chronological_index: Dense zero-based index over official-runner-consumed nonempty rounds.

question_projection.answer_isolation: The adapter returns no raw answer field. It returns answer_sha256 and qa_canonical_sha256 solely to bind the projection to the accepted question index.
question_projection.textual_retrieval_query:
Append exactly '
question's image:
image_caption: <caption>' only when both a question image and caption exist, matching official text-memory recall.
question_projection.answer_query: Keep the original question separate; the future answer wrapper owns speaker/category formatting and question-image attachment.
question_projection.identity_check: qid, scenario, qa_index, question_sha256, answer_sha256, and qa_canonical_sha256 must exactly match the accepted question-index row in order.

strictness_delta: Reject path traversal, absolute paths, malformed image metadata, and non-string dialogue/question fields instead of warning and continuing.
Reject any query projection carrying a raw answer field.
Reject denominator, order, or identity drift against the accepted question index.

covered_invariants: official speaker naming and caption folding
official first-image selection and safe path normalization
empty-round skipping with source-index-stable memory ids
question-image caption used only for retrieval projection
raw-answer omission and frozen question identity validation
malformed image metadata and traversal rejection

next_gate: After accepted dataset integrity, run this exact adapter over all 20 scenarios in a fresh no-score lifecycle root, verify 1711 ordered query identities and the measured consumed-round count, and archive the projection hashes before endpoint or numerical execution.
authorization: This artifact does not authorize reading the real dataset before its integrity acceptance, model service launch, embeddings, answer generation, numerical runs, scoring, result admission, claims, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: passing raw answers into retrieval, prompting, logging, or model-visible structures
silently consuming more than the first conversation image while claiming official-runner fidelity
reindexing memory ids after a skipped source round
changing folding, speaker, image, or identity semantics after score observation
using synthetic projection tests as baseline quality evidence
